title: Pricing matrices action columns show no sort arrow, even on hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA07 alpha) exists, so its row shows the duplicate, edit and delete icons.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA07 Beta) exists.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Hold the mouse pointer over the header cell above the duplicate icons.
  4. Hold the mouse pointer over the header cell above the edit icons.
  5. Hold the mouse pointer over the header cell above the delete icons.
  6. Click the header cell above the edit icons.
  7. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  8. Read the order of {Matrix-A} and {Matrix-B} and look at every header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 to 5: no arrow appears in these header cells and nothing about them changes to suggest they can be sorted.
  • Step 8: the list is unchanged ({Matrix-A} above {Matrix-B}). Only the Matrix Category header shows an arrow, pointing up.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), §2 Sort arrows, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Pricing matrices), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.   • PRD §2 Sort arrows: “A column that cannot be sorted shows no arrow and gives no hover affordance.”
  • PRD §2 Sort arrows: “Only the column being sorted shows an arrow.”
